name: cemetery_recruitment_non_zombie_draws_nothing
note: Cemetery Recruitment: 'Return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand. If it's a Zombie card, draw a card.' P0 returns a Human Soldier creature card: it goes to P0's hand and, not being a Zombie, P0 draws nothing (one card in hand, the library untouched). The Zombie card beside it in the graveyard stays there.
